comprehension_topics.product_purpose: Decision-support software for electricity-cost management for lower-middle UMKM.
comprehension_topics.product_disclaimers: Not an official PLN app, energy audit, electrical diagnosis, or guaranteed savings platform.
comprehension_topics.supported_umkm_scope: Kos Knowledge Pack V1 (Token per kamar & regular electrical systems).
comprehension_topics.user_journey: Tagihan naik → memahami perubahan → bagian yang perlu diperiksa → pemeriksaan → tindakan hemat → evaluasi tagihan berikutnya.
comprehension_topics.runtime_architecture: Next.js 16.2.11 App Router, Node 24.x, Vercel Serverless Functions in sin1.
comprehension_topics.database_architecture: Neon Serverless PostgreSQL 17.10 (aws-ap-southeast-1), Drizzle ORM, 14 tables.
comprehension_topics.tenant_isolation_contracts: Strict business_id / user_id ownership checks on all API & page routes.
comprehension_topics.entitlement_contracts: Plan choice choice gating (DASHBOARD_ENABLED, MONTHLY_REPORT_ENABLED, ENTITLEMENTS_ENABLED).
comprehension_topics.authentication_contracts: Better Auth session management, HttpOnly SameSite secure cookies.
comprehension_topics.migration_rules: Forward-only DDL migrations 0000-0007 UP; zero SQL DOWN migrations on Production.
comprehension_topics.production_environment_contract: Production scope only; DATABASE_URL pooled, DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED direct, rotated BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.
comprehension_topics.security_constraints: Zero plain-text secrets in code/logs/evidence, strict TLS (sslmode=verify-full), unsafe-eval absent.
comprehension_topics.privacy_constraints: Zero real customer PII in test data or evidence; sanitized fingerprints only.
comprehension_topics.rollback_rules: Staged verification before promotion; instant vercel rollback or emergency deployment containment.
comprehension_topics.operational_ownership: Release Operator (Agent), Incident Decision Owner (Product Owner).
comprehension_topics.accepted_risks: PostCSS build-time advisory accepted; brace-expansion dev-only advisory accepted.
comprehension_topics.forbidden_actions: No custom domain config, no DNS changes, no paid upgrades, no PR, no merge to main.
